items.question: Do I need prior marketing experience?
items.answer: No specific background is required to explore this program. We recommend discussing your current skills and goals with the team so you can choose the right starting point.

items.question: How long is the training?
items.answer: The planned training duration is 5 months of training. Ask the team for current batch schedules, delivery format and fees.

items.question: Is an internship guaranteed?
items.answer: Internship opportunities depend on eligibility, selection and availability. Please confirm the current terms with the admissions team.

items.question: Will I build a portfolio?
items.answer: The learning path includes practical exercises that can become portfolio examples. Your final portfolio depends on the work you complete.

items.question: How is this different from the other programs?
items.answer: All four programs share AI and digital marketing foundations. The longer programs add professional communication, creative media skills or both.

sections.heading: Let’s make the next step clear.
sections.description: Ask about the curriculum, current batches, fees and internship eligibility. We will help you compare the four learning paths.
